sections.title: Adv.  Principles of Nurse Anesthesia Practice: Obstetrics, Pediatrics, & Women of Childbearing Age
sections.description: This course focuses on theory and research from the behavioral and nursing sciences on the psychological and social consequences of on-going illness. In addition, the health policy issues engendered by these problems will be addressed. Prerequisite: Primary Care Majors or instructor permission
